name: waread
description: waread: schreibgeschützter WhatsApp-Leser für den Raspberry Pi

scripts.build: npm run build -w @waread/db && npm run build -w waread-ingest && npm run build -w waread-web && npm run build -w waread-frontend && npm run build -w waread-cleanup
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @waread/db && npm run typecheck -w waread-ingest && npm run typecheck -w waread-web && npm run typecheck -w waread-frontend && npm run typecheck -w waread-cleanup
scripts.test: npm run test -w @waread/db && npm run test -w waread-ingest && npm run test -w waread-web && npm run test -w waread-cleanup && npm run test -w waread-frontend
